Teaching

I have taught since 2014: English to school and university students in Iran, and since 2023 teacher education and graduate TESOL courses at the University of Kansas. At Kansas I have taught seven courses as instructor of record, 16 sections so far, most of them more than once. Two more sections are assigned for Spring 2027.

University of Kansas

Instructor of record and graduate teaching assistant, Department of Curriculum & Teaching, 2023 to present.

Courses, most taught first

C&T 330
6sections

Instructional Approaches for ESOL Learners in the Elementary/Early Childhood Classroom

UndergraduateEvery fall and spring, Spring 2024 to Fall 2026

Teaching English learners in elementary and early childhood classrooms: who English learners are, the programs that serve them, core ESL methods, and building classroom materials.

C&T 235
3sections

Cultural Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion in K‑12 Schools

Teacher education foundationsFall 2023 (two sections) and Spring 2024

How culture, identity and community shape students’ experience of K‑12 school, taught through discussion and shared problem solving.

C&T 423
2sections

Assessing English Language Learners

UndergraduateSummer 2025 and Summer 2026

Assessing English learners in U.S. PreK‑12 schools with equity in view: the purposes of assessment, academic language, and using results with students, families and communities.

C&T 825
2sections

Advanced Practicum in TESOL

GraduateFall 2025 and Spring 2026

Supervised teaching for future ESL and bilingual teachers in elementary, secondary or adult settings: observation, lesson planning, classroom management and self-evaluation.

C&T 821
2sections

Assessment in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages

GraduateFall 2024 and Spring 2027

Graduate course on diagnosing second language development across the four skills, including research on error analysis.

C&T 331
2sections

Instructional Approaches for ESOL Learners in Secondary Schools

UndergraduateSpring 2025 and Spring 2027

Taught in Spring 2025 under its earlier title, Instructional Approaches for ESOL Learners in the Middle/Secondary Classroom.

The same foundations for future middle and secondary teachers of every subject, so they can support the English learners in their classes.

C&T 820
1section

Teaching English as a Second Language/Bilingual Education

GraduateFall 2026

Graduate methods for ESL and bilingual education: teaching listening, speaking, reading and writing, the place of culture, and evaluating one’s own teaching and materials.

Teaching in Iran

University of Isfahan 2018 to 2022

EFL instructor for undergraduate and graduate students, about 250 instructional hours. In 2019 I received the university’s Distinguished EFL Instructor award.

  • 1716404 English as a Foreign Language I, undergraduate, 2018 to 2022
  • 1716405 English as a Foreign Language II, undergraduate, 2018 to 2022
  • E8012 English as an Academic Language, graduate, 2020 to 2022

IranCanada Educational Center Aug 2021 to Nov 2022

English as a second language teacher, on contract, Tehran Province.

Vank School (Armenian) 2020 to 2022

EFL teacher in Isfahan, teaching English as a foreign language to students whose first languages were Armenian and Persian (Farsi).

Farhangian University 2014 to 2016

EFL instructor in Sabzevar, teaching English as a foreign language to students in grades 6 and 8. I also designed and validated English language tests for grades 6 to 8.
